div.head: V Atr 31.1
div.ab: ⁊ gyf he ongean riht þurh æhlyp geonbyrde ⁊ swa gewyrce, þæt hine man afylle, licge ægylde eallan his freondan.
⁊ gif he ongean riht þurh æhlyp geonbyrde ⁊ swa gewyrce, þæt hine man afylle, licge ægylde eallum his freondan.
⁊ gif he ongean riht geonbyrde oððe æhlip gewirce, ⁊ hine man þonne þurh þæt afille, licge ægilde eallum his freondum.
And gyf he ongean riht þurh æhlyp geonbyrde and swa gewyrce, þæt hine man afylle, licge ægylde eallan his freondan.
And if he offers resistance to the course of justice or commits a breach of the law, and through that brings about his own death, no compensation shall be paid for him to any of his friends.
And if he resists the law with violence and, so doing, causes his own death, no wergild shall be paid to his friends.
And if he illegally offers resistance with assault, and so brings it about that he is killed, no wergild is to be paid to any of his friends.

Und wenn er gegen das Recht durch Gewalt ankämpft (oder Gewalt verübt und nun deshalb D) und so veranlasst, dass er erschlagen wird, liege er todt, allen seinen Freunden nicht [durch Wergeld] entgolten.
And if he resists the law by assault (or commits assault and therefore, D) and so brings it about that he is killed, let him lie uncompensated [by wergild] to all his friends.
div.note: þæt hine man: and hine man þonne þurh þæt D
